feeds.title: TABI » Cartomancy
feeds.description: TABI (The Tarot Association of the British Isles) is a not-for-profit association run with a passion for Tarot and esoteric reading. We provide support, information and resources for Tarot enthusiasts. Our blog is filled with reviews on Cartomancy cards, books, and a lot more.

feeds.title: New World Witchery » Cartomancy
feeds.description: Cory & Laine the authors of New World Witchery have studied their way into learning these traits. Their blog is full of cartomancy, children's lore, divination, folk magic, folk magician's notebook, folklore, love magic, lunar calendar, lunar eclipse, magic and more. They also have a podcast in which they speak about roses, stories, tarot, witch, witchcraft, and witchery.

feeds.title: Jack Chanek » Cartomancy
feeds.description: Jack Chanek is an author, tarot reader and witch. Tarot for him was food for thought and is a Gardnerian Wiccan priest who believes in magic, divination and supernatural powers. Jack of Wands Tarot has a detailed blog on Cartomancy, tarot, numerology and more.

feeds.title: Patheos Blog | The Cartomancer
feeds.description: Patheos is the premier online destination to engage in the global dialogue about religion. You can expect to read a lot on our blog about method, logic, magic, and Zen in reading Tarot, Marseille, Lenormand, and Playing cards.

feeds.title: TAROFLEXIONS
feeds.description: Camelia has a passion for seeing the obvious. She reads cards like the Devil and tells fortunes from a martial arts, Zen perspective. Her blog is filled with her own experiences and knowledge. Stay in the loop for cartomancy activities at Aradia Academy, new releases from flash insights and much more.
